why: LITERAL-GROUND (2026-10-11). Sentence embeddings cannot separate a preposition's functional use from its rare senses: on the pt r3 deck 'by means of; by' won 11 of 26 'de' sentences and 'in (wearing)' won 'lembrar-se de'. Primary leaves are declared here because the Wiktionary menu is sorted by sense id, not by Wiktionary's own order.

not_guarded.por: for / by / through / per are all common; a declared primary would overwrite real uses
not_guarded.para: 'to' is as common as 'for'; a 'for' primary turned 'mudei para Boston' into 'for' on the pt sample
not_guarded.a: 'a' + infinitive is the European progressive ('estou a ser'), not 'towards'; and Spanish showed a destination prior overwrites real uses

active_card_threshold: not here: the app moves a sense under 10% of a card's sentences to Rarer uses (MAIN_CARD_MIN_SHARE, app/js/vocab.js), pooled by translation for prepositions
